_note: The player's heartbeat (Dave 9 Nov 2026, docs/design/heartbeat_design.md): the Daggorath pulse, always heard. bpm is a straight line of the server's strain: rest_bpm at strain 0, faint_bpm at exertion.json faint_at, peak_bpm at the most over-exerted; the server's own rate (sleep, faint, waking) wins while it sends one. The volume goes in a straight line from rest_db at rest_bpm to peak_db at peak_bpm. The bar above the hotbar spreads to max_half_px each way on a beat in rise_s and eases back to min_half_px by the next; its colour is the last zone whose from_bpm the rate has reached.
